subject: Renewal uplift & seat-transfer request — proposed terms
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@clearvista.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal uplift & seat-transfer request — proposed terms

Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed path so procurement has something concise to review: 

Summary of ask from ClearVista:
- Mid-contract uplift of committed units to accommodate new AI team (est. +35% consumption for next 6 months)
- Move 120 seats from "R&D" bucket to "Customer Facing" bucket (no net seat increase, just re-allocation)
- Desire for co-term to align all licenses to 2027-01-31 and consolidated monthly invoicing
- Request for temporary surge protection (auto-burst) while they ramp, and a one-time credit if actual usage < forecast

Our proposed commercial levers (high level):
- Blended uplift discount: 22% off list for the incremental units for remainder of term (customer asks ~30%); we can soften to 25% with executive sign-off
- Surge protection: 6 months of a 150% burst cap on top of committed units; any excess billed at pay-as-you-go list rates, with 200k-token one-time buffer credit if ClearVista under-uses the buffer
- Seat transfer: allowed administratively once with no charge provided total committed units remain unchanged; requires an ops request and 10 business days lead time
- Co-term: pro-rate incremental uplift to align to 2027-01-31; monthly invoice option OK once PO is received

Attached: draft SOW and pricing worksheet (redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx) with line-item math.

Next steps: if procurement confirms the core asks, I'll route to legal for a short amendment + DocuSign and loop in Marcus for executive approval of the 25% concession. Please flag any must-have constraints from your side.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment(s): redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx, ClearVista_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@clearvista.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearvista.ai
Date: 2026-06-23T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal uplift & seat-transfer request — proposed terms

Jordan — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications / asks from procurement and our finance lead: 

1) Discount: ClearVista is under tight budget scrutiny this quarter. They asked if we can target 30% off list on the uplift for the next 6 months instead of 22–25. Is that strictly off the table?

2) Billing cadence: we prefer monthly consolidated invoicing (one invoice covering all buckets) and a single PO workflow. Confirm this is doable.

3) Surge protection: procurement wants the auto-burst but with a hard cap and predictable overage math — they will not accept an unlimited burst. Is the 150% burst figure negotiable to a hard cap (they asked for 140%)? Also want a clear definition for when the one-time buffer credit applies (e.g., if actual burst usage < 50% of allocated buffer).

4) Security/legal: our security team still needs the SOC 2 evidence and a short data-retention SLA added to the amendment. Can you route SOC docs?

If you can send a short (1-page) commercial amendment showing the uplift math, the proposed discount, and the burst cap language, procurement can do an expedited review. Thanks — Alex

On Tue, Jun 21, 2026 at 9:18 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a proposed path so procurement has something concise to review: ...

Best,
Alex
Head of Procurement | ClearVista AI
alex.brown@clearvista.ai

Attachment(s): none

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Renewal uplift & seat-transfer request — proposed terms

Folks — forwarding ClearVista's procurement reply. Key negotiation asks: 30% discount target, hard cap on burst (they asked 140%), monthly consolidated invoicing, SOC2 + short retention SLA.

I recommend we proceed as follows (so I can send a one-page amendment):
- Offer: move to a 25% blended discount on incremental uplift (we can make 27% if Marcus signs off) — keeps margin while signaling concession
- Burst cap: commit to a hard burst cap of 150% (vs their 140%) but add predictable overage math: any usage above burst cap billed at 1.5x list rate and excludes credits. Include a clause that auto-burst requires completion of a short ops form and 10 days notice to enable
- Buffer credit: define as a one-time credit equal to the cost of 200k tokens if total burst utilization < 50% of allocated buffer across the 6-month window
- SOC2: attach SOC2 report and offer a 30-day window to complete retention SLA language with legal

I've attached the pricing worksheet with line item calculations and a redlined one-pager commercial amendment (draft SOW is also attached). Need Marcus to confirm approval threshold for moving to 27% vs 25%. Olga/Laura — flag any CS or ops constraints (seat transfer logistics, invoicing details).

Thanks — Jordan

Attachment(s): redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx, ClearVista_SOW_v2.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-24T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal uplift & seat-transfer request — proposed terms

Jordan — reviewed. Approve the negotiation path with one tweak on the discount ladder: offer 25% as standard, but add an explicit sales-exec escalation path to 27% if ClearVista signs within 5 business days and agrees to the co-term on 2027-01-31. That gives urgency and a bounded concession.

Also approve the burst language but change the overage multiplier to 1.25x (not 1.5x) — more defensible and easier for procurement to accept. Keep the 150% burst cap. Ops will need 10 business days to complete the seat transfer; Laura, please confirm calendar availability for July.

Jordan — please send the 1-page amendment and include SOC2 link. I'll pre-approve the 27% escalation if they meet the sign window and PO terms.

Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Revenue — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com

Attachment(s): none
